title: Six Asschers
subtitle: Six step-cut squares in a line, each opening onto its own depth.

stone.origin: The Asscher cut is not about fire — it is about depth. Step facets draw the eye downward through concentric squares, creating a hall-of-mirrors effect that no brilliant cut can produce. Six of them set together in sequence compound that effect: each stone's depth connects to the next, and the visual field runs through all six simultaneously. The pendant was built to hold six Asschers in a line without interruption.

metal: 18K gold The Asscher cut is not about fire — it is about depth
description: The Asscher is not a cut about fire — it is a cut about depth. Its step facets draw the eye downward through concentric squares, a hall-of-mirrors effect no brilliant can produce. Set six in a row, that effect compounds: each stone's depth connects to the next, and the eye travels through all six at once. The pendant was built to hold them in an uninterrupted line, corner to corner, so the sequence reads as one long descent of light in eighteen-karat gold.
